gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-tagbanw: Noto Sans Tagbanwa opens its curves with clear gaps and lets its lowercase fill most of the line height, quite unlike the heading. Starborn floats with wide spaces and dark lowercase, while the sans keeps things grounded.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Quietly approachable, this body has strokes that taper off before they touch and hardly any step from capital to lowercase. Noto Sans Tai Le keeps paragraphs smooth and unfussy beneath Starborn's dreamy, widely spaced display letters.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-tai-tha: Noto Sans Tai Tham packs its lowercase up toward the capital line, with each c showing its open inside. And Starborn drifts above it, dreamy and widely spaced, best when big and brief.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-tai-vie: Noto Sans Tai Viet has short ascenders, a tall x-height and terminals pulled back from where curves would close. Noto Sans Tai Viet against Starborn's dreamy gaps and dark lowercase stripe gives the pair its spark: airy above, sturdy below.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri leaves every small round letter generously unclosed and carries a high-waisted lowercase beneath the heading. Starborn's wide gaps float over that plain sans.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil reads as if magnified without any change of size, its terminals stopping well away from the stem. Starborn does dreamy and dramatic; the sans-serif does plain, steady text.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-tamil-s: Stocky lines, open curves, a dreamy top. Starborn does its best work with generous spacing and a dark lowercase stripe, whereas Noto Sans Tamil Supplement shines in its round forms that read like open parentheses beneath a tall middle band.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Starborn drifts with huge gaps between letters and a thick, dark band of lowercase running through each line, ethereal and dreamy. Its partner, Noto Sans Tangsa, brings wide, welcoming round letters and short ascender stems.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-tc: Starborn spreads ethereal, dreamy letters with big blank gaps and a dark lowercase stripe through every line. And Noto Sans TC follows with large open counters in tall a, e and s, so extended text would go down smoothly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu reads with a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside, businesslike but unfussy. Starborn adds a dreamy, widely spaced top, and Noto Sans Telugu is the plain sans that keeps the text beneath it readable.
